hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cherry-creek-state-park/cherry-creek-state-park-camping-lodging ('Full hook-up and tent campsites are available year-round'; 'Power connection') + cpwshop site details (Abilene, Buffalo, Coyote, Gold Rush, Pioneer Full Hookup: 'Full Hookup' 50, 'Electricity Hookup' '20/30/50', Water 'Y', Sewer 'Y'), read 2026-10-12/2026-10-26

values.note: 102 full-hookup sites in the Abilene, Buffalo, Coyote, Gold Rush and Pioneer loops (vehicles 70-80 ft, many pull-through) and 30 basic sites in Cottonwood Grove (gravel back-ins, vehicles 25-40 ft, offered for RVs, trailers and tents); CPW counts 135 with the group sites. One RV or camper per site, six people, two vehicles.

sites.source: https://www.cpwshop.com/camping/cherry-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=50022 (site list: 100 Full Hookup + 2 Full Hookup - ADA + 30 Basic + 3 Group Camping; site details Maximum Vehicle Length 70-80 full hookup, 25-40 Basic, Driveway Entry Pull-Through/Back-In; Basic 'Looking For Category': 'RV Site,Tent Site,Trailer Site') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cherry-creek-state-park/cherry-creek-state-park-camping-lodging ('135 Campsites'; 'A maximum of six people, two camping units (but only one RV or camper per site) and two vehicles'), read 2026-10-12/2026-10-26

values.note: Camper services building with coin showers and laundry (may close seasonally); the dump station is closed November 1 - March 31. Firewood for sale; an amphitheater in the campground.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cherry-creek-state-park/cherry-creek-state-park-camping-lodging ('The campground offers shower and laundry facilities, a dump station and firewood for purchase'; 'Camper services building with coin-operated showers and laundry facilities'; 'The dump station is closed for the winter and reopens April 1. Showers and laundry facilities may be closed seasonally.'; winter amenities 'Flush toilets'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Winter camping (November 1 - March 31) is in the Abilene Loop only.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cherry-creek-state-park/cherry-creek-state-park-camping-lodging ('Full hook-up and tent campsites are available year-round'; 'Winter camping (November 1-March 31) is available in the Abilene Loop only, and a reservation is required'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: A reservation is required, including in winter: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, not at the park. Camping is limited to 14 days in any 45-day period; permits are renewed by noon at the office or a self-service kiosk.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cherry-creek-state-park/cherry-creek-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Cherry Creek ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations cannot be made at the park.'; 'Camping is limited to 14 days in any 45-day period.'; 'Camping permits need to be renewed by noon or the site vacated. A self-service kiosk is available'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Basic sites $28 a night, full hookups $41 (June 2027 reads, Saturday the same; CPW's park page gives campsites $28-$41). Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($10-$15 at Cherry Creek) or an annual pass.

fees.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cherry-creek-state-park/cherry-creek-state-park-camping-lodging (Campsite '1 Night' '$28 -$41') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cherry-creek-state-park ('Daily Vehicle Pass: $10-$15') + audit/state_park_fees/co_sites_2026-10-12.jsonl + co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop per-site reads for parkID 50022) (Cottonwood Grove Basic $28.00/night, full-hookup loops $41.00/night, 06/15/2027 and Sat 06/19/2027), read 2026-10-26

Added 50 A/water/sewer, 132 individual sites (102 full hookup + 30 basic RV-capable) to 80 ft with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/flush toilets, year-round season (winter Abilene Loop only), 14 nights in 45 days, deep booking URL.
